items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: the Hurt Getson, and the Chattis, and during that time, we used to play those kinds.

ctx.x: Were they still playing? Oh, that time, waltzes, and the Hurt Getson, and the Chattis, and during that time, we used to play those kinds. It was real Dixieland it was that time.
That was with the dance band? That was the dance band, yeah.
